related_questions.question: How much does the dendritic cell vaccine cost?

text_blocks.snippet: The cost of dendritic cell vaccines varies widely, ranging from $20,000 to $135,000 or more per treatment course, depending on factors such as the specific vaccine, the treatment center, and whether it's part of a clinical trial or FDA-approved. Some individual treatments can cost $45,000 per infusion, according to GoodRx.
snippet_highlighted_words: $20,000 to $135,000 or more per treatment course

list.title: Type of Vaccine:
list.snippet: Different dendritic cell vaccines are designed for specific cancers, and their manufacturing and development costs can vary, impacting the overall price, according to medtour.help.

list.title: FDA Approval Status:
list.snippet: FDA-approved vaccines, like Provenge (sipuleucel-T), may have different cost structures compared to vaccines still in clinical trials or those not approved in a particular region.

list.title: Manufacturing and Preparation Costs:
list.snippet: The process of isolating and processing dendritic cells from the patient's body, as well as creating the vaccine, involves significant laboratory work and specialized facilities, adding to the cost.

list.title: Clinical Trial Costs:
list.snippet: If the vaccine is part of a clinical trial, there may be additional costs associated with trial participation, such as monitoring and follow-up appointments.

list.title: Treatment Center and Location:
list.snippet: Treatment costs can vary between hospitals, clinics, and research centers, and may be influenced by the cost of living in that area.

list.title: Individual Treatment Needs:
list.snippet: The number of doses required, the need for additional therapies, and the patient's overall health status can also affect the final cost.

text_blocks.snippet: Examples of Dendritic Cell Vaccine Costs:

list.snippet: Provenge (sipuleucel-T): In the US, a course of Provenge (sipuleucel-T) for prostate cancer can cost around $90,000, according to medtour.help.
IO-VAK: In Germany, a dendritic cell vaccine (IO-VAK) may cost around $55,000 per course.
DCVax: In clinical trials, the estimated cost for DCVax-L for glioblastoma is around $37,000 per course.
T-VEC (Imlygic®): In the US, this oncolytic virus vaccine for melanoma costs around $65,000.
Other therapies: Dendritic cell therapy in Germany can range from 20,000 to 38,000 euros.
Hematology ward costs: One study analyzed the costs of dendritic cell vaccine preparation, which was €20,450 per patient.

related_questions.question: How has immunotherapy changed the landscape of cancer treatment in the 21st century?
related_questions.snippet: Abstract. Immunotherapy has changed the environment of cancer treatment by providing new and efficacious therapy options for many solid and hematologic malignancies. Although not a new field of oncology, immunotherapy has quickly developed into one of the most flourishing fields in medicine.
